serverInfo.name: kcore
serverInfo.title: kcore MCP server
serverInfo.description: kcore ships an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server with the controller for VM and node management. It is not exposed as a public HTTPS endpoint on kcorehypervisor.com; run it on your own cluster and point your MCP client at that deployment. See documentation for installation and configuration.

transports.note: stdio or configured streamable HTTP per your kcore release; see product docs.
